coachView.name: FileNetImport
coachView.layout:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><ns2:layout xmlns:ns2="http://www.ibm.com/bpm/CoachDesignerNG" xmlns:ns3="http://www.ibm.com/bpm/coachview"><ns2:layoutItem xsi:type="ns2:CustomHTML" version="8550" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"><ns2:id>04eed06f-3c0d-4e2a-9e26-f35bcb1c8c1b</ns2:id><ns2:layoutItemId>CustomHTML1</ns2:layoutItemId><ns2:configData><ns2:id>48675feb-d07f-4db8-964f-856903e5da0c</ns2:id><ns2:optionName>@customHTML.contentType</ns2:optionName><ns2:value>TEXT</ns2:value></ns2:configData><ns2:configData><ns2:id>dd982e07-77c6-4112-b590-6d5bab1a03a9</ns2:id><ns2:optionName>@customHTML.textContent</ns2:optionName><ns2:value><div class="fnimport-widget" role="region" aria-label="FileNet Document Import">

  <!-- Drop Zone -->
  <div class="fnimport-dropzone"
       role="region"
       aria-label="Drop zone for files and folders"
       aria-describedby="fnimport-dropzone-hint"
       tabindex="0">
    <div class="fnimport-dropzone-icon" aria-hidden="true">
      <div class="fnimport-icon-upload"></div>
    </div>
    <p class="fnimport-dropzone-title">Drop documents or folders here</p>
    <p class="fnimport-dropzone-subtitle" id="fnimport-dropzone-hint">
      Drag and drop a single document, multiple documents, or entire folder structures. Subfolders are preserved for folder imports.
    </p>
    <div class="fnimport-browse-actions" role="group" aria-label="Browse import sources">
      <button class="fnimport-browse-btn fnimport-browse-files-btn" type="button" aria-label="Browse documents to upload">
        Browse documents
      </button>
      <button class="fnimport-browse-btn fnimport-browse-folder-btn" type="button" aria-label="Browse a folder to upload">
        Browse folder
      </button>
    </div>
    <input class="fnimport-file-input"
           type="file"
           multiple
           aria-hidden="true"
           tabindex="-1" />
    <input class="fnimport-folder-input"
           type="file"
           multiple
           webkitdirectory
           directory
           aria-hidden="true"
           tabindex="-1" />
  </div>

  <!-- Status Bar -->
  <div class="fnimport-statusbar" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false">
    <span class="fnimport-status-text"></span>
    <div class="fnimport-progress-bar" role="progressbar" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="0">
      <div class="fnimport-progress-fill"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- File Queue -->
  <div class="fnimport-queue" role="list" aria-label="Files queued for import">
    <!-- Items injected by JS -->
  </div>

  <!-- Action Bar -->
  <div class="fnimport-actions" style="display: none;">
    <button class="fnimport-btn-import" type="button" aria-label="Import all queued files" disabled>
      <span class="fnimport-btn-icon fnimport-icon-cloud-upload" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      Import
    </button>
    <button class="fnimport-btn-clear" type="button" aria-label="Clear all queued files">
      Clear all
    </button>
  </div>

  <!-- Result Log -->
  <div class="fnimport-log" role="log" aria-label="Import results" aria-live="polite">
    <!-- Log entries injected by JS -->
  </div>

</div></ns2:value></ns2:configData></ns2:layoutItem></ns2:layout>
coachView.description: Drag-and-drop document and folder import widget for IBM FileNet Content Engine via GraphQL, used in IBM Business Automation Workflow

configOption.name: graphqlEndpoint
configOption.label: GraphQL Endpoint
configOption.description: Full URL of the FileNet Content Engine GraphQL API endpoint

configOption.name: parentFolderPath
configOption.label: Parent Folder Path
configOption.description: FileNet folder path where files will be imported

configOption.name: maxFileSizeMB
configOption.label: Max File Size (MB)
configOption.description: Maximum allowed file size in megabytes

configOption.name: allowedMimeTypes
configOption.label: Allowed MIME Types
configOption.description: Comma-separated list of accepted MIME types (empty = all types)

configOption.name: documentClassIdentifier
configOption.label: Document Class Identifier
configOption.description: Optional FileNet document class identifier (symbolic name)

configOption.name: folderClassIdentifier
configOption.label: Folder Class Identifier
configOption.description: Optional FileNet folder class identifier (symbolic name)

configOption.name: onImportComplete
configOption.label: On Import Complete
configOption.description: Event fired when import completes successfully

configOption.name: onImportError
configOption.label: On Import Error
configOption.description: Event fired when import encounters errors

configOption.name: onFileAdded
configOption.label: On File Added
configOption.description: Event fired when a file is added to the import queue
